reason: User input flows through doSomething() via Base64 encode/decode roundtrip (preserves content), then concatenates into SQL string which is written to response via getWriter().println(). The ESAPI encoder protects the results toString() but the SQL string itself (containing user input) is also echoed to response, enabling XSS.
